title: Explore joint frame retiming after carried swaps (ongoing; no new κ)
body:
PR4971 removes forced common-frame contacts at 534 weighted field swaps, but its invoice is unchanged. This draft tests joint retiming on those crossed field paths, with both helper boundaries and owned center contacts variable and main endpoints fixed.

The exact baseline has 16,199 nodes, 29,974 paid edges (including original zero edges and all eight centers), and 240 native occurrences. It reconstructs the complete source P/H invoice and reruns the credited all-632-input swap replay in both orientations. Wrong-rank and noninvertible-map controls reject.

Bounded floating discovery found no negative complete local moment delta at C=.00302177581 across 511 common hyperplane cuts, 3,449 specified compound kernels and 144 charged kernel/Pauli contact models. Saved compressed receipts and optional discovery commands are included. These are search results, not an exact optimum or universal barrier. Lower call-count seeds can still worsen the actual moment. Compound deletion/extension basin exploration continues separately; no improving physical supplier or higher kappa is claimed.

Only research/carried-frame-frontier differs from current canonical main bee95ce88f9f19802f0613f92838895cd0e14a1f. PR4971's integrated scientific bytes remain unchanged; source/history and contribution credit are explicit. The selected conditional kappa remains .00302015. No selected-record, shared verifier, main-branch merge or theorem change is requested.

Validation at f61879619af66faaf4f53aa71ce8717188e37901: Python 3.12 registered baseline replay, metadata/source pins, committed-byte and source-history preflight, 32-file official export and export integrity pass. The optimizer is optional and not an acceptance test. No fresh new-operator phase admission, full controller/compiler/BIT/outer replay, formal proof or independent human review is claimed. Hosted CI has not yet been checked.

Credit Dugongue/PR4971, Cao Yifan/PR4610 and round-three work, Cinna Davis's PR4470/4672/4690/4694/4698 lineage, zxv, Jacob Alan Sussman and retained NOTICE authors. Prepared by Cinna Davis with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents; Apache-2.0.

Open next question: can a strict full moment gain be emitted with arbitrary-input correctness and absolute phase, then survive the complete controller and outer ledger?
